fatal_gates.F1: prior terminal evidence and historical archive records remain immutable; only eligibility/index state may change
fatal_gates.F2: no richer-mode/manual-user/external hosted registry, finite quota, or incremental monetary cost

guards: G1 every accepted elite is durably bound to an exact scope_version token
G2 a new scope_version does not delete or rewrite prior elites
G3 an elite with a nonmatching scope_version is ineligible for ranking, switching, or credit transfer in the new scope
G4 historical utility from an old scope cannot satisfy a new-scope aspiration threshold
G5 re-evaluation under the current scope may create a new current-scope record without mutating the old record
G6 current-scope replacement requires terminal readback and same-scope comparison
G7 stale/duplicate completion tagged with the prior scope_version cannot update current eligibility or credit
G8 eligibility pointer/index updates use expected-old CAS/readback; transport failure is non-semantic
G9 scope versions are compact monotonic role-local tokens and archive retention remains bounded by declared policy
G10 bounded exact-scope exit with nonempty frontier; no credit for version migration itself

candidate_patterns.pattern: reuse old elite utility unchanged after scope change because candidate id matches
delete all old elites on scope change and start from an empty archive
retain immutable historical elites tagged scope7; current scope8 accepts only scope8 terminal evidence; re-evaluated same candidate becomes a separate scope8 record
delegate scope validation to an external hosted metadata registry

required_safe_effects: scope7 A remains immutable historical evidence
scope7 utility cannot outrank scope8 work
scope8 re-evaluation does not mutate scope7 record

score_rule: Fatal F1/F2 failure => 0. Otherwise one point per G1-G10 PASS. Do not modify scope tokens or guards after source read.
credit_rule: No credit for scope migration or validator match. At most one credit only after source-qualified Chat-native version gating passes this fixed trace and immutable terminal evidence is independently read back.
exact_next_action: Read primary RFC semantics for strong entity tags and conditional matching, bind only version-validator semantics, assess zero dependency/quota/cost, execute SV-A..SV-D against this fixed trace, and seal/read back terminal evidence.
